land_pattern.notes: Datasheet provides the package outline only (3 LEAD SOT-223, AMS DRW# 042292) - NO recommended land pattern drawing. From the outline: lead pitch 0.090in (2.29mm) NOM; lead width 0.025-0.033in (0.64-0.84mm); tab width 0.116-0.124in (2.95-3.15mm); body 6.30-6.71 x 3.30-3.71mm; overall lead-tip to tab-tip span 6.71-7.29mm; height 1.80mm max; lead thickness 0.25-0.36mm. Pad sizes not vendor-specified - use a standard SOT-223 land pattern. pad_count 4 = 3 leads + tab pad.
